name: Jinhsi

tierList.prydwen: T2 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes (as of patch 3.2 review)

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Broadblade Main DPS. Magistrate of Jinzhou. Rotation revolves around a Forte gauge (Incandescence, max 50) built by party attribute/coordinated-attack damage, spent on an empowered Resonance Skill nuke (Illuminous Epiphany) reached via a mid-air 'Incarnation' stance.

skills.normalAttack: Slash of Breaking Dawn - up to 4 consecutive Spectro strikes; heavy/mid-air/dodge-counter variants.
skills.resonanceSkill: Trailing Lights of Eons (dash + strikes); after Basic Attack 4 or Intro, alternative Resonance Skill 'Overflowing Radiance' becomes available for 5s, dealing Spectro DMG and entering Incarnation.
skills.forte: Luminal Synthesis / Incarnation stance: alternate basic/skill/heavy/dodge kit while airborne; after Incarnation Basic P4, cast 'Crescent Divinity' then empowered nuke 'Illuminous Epiphany' which consumes up to 50 Incandescence for scaling bonus DMG and grants a free Outro (Unison) usable once per 25s.
skills.liberation: Purge of Light - Spectro DMG nuke, castable mid-air.
skills.intro: Loong's Halo - Spectro DMG, can instantly trigger Incarnation.
skills.outro: Temporal Bender - accelerates Incandescence generation from same-attribute damage (1 stack/1s for 20s) for the incoming character.

echoSet: Celestial Light (5pc, +10% Spectro DMG base, +30% for 15s after Intro)

mainStats.cost3: Spectro DMG (main echo Jué); Spectro DMG >= ATK%

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Standard Hypercarry/Coordinated-Attack team; Verina stronger if CRIT consistency isn't a concern, otherwise Shorekeeper.

teams.name: Quickswap Team
teams.notes: Higher rotation flexibility, harder to pilot, requires Verina for Coordinated Attacks.

teams.name: Budget Team
teams.notes: Mortefi strong only with heavy Empyrean Anthem investment; otherwise Yuanwu on Rejuvenating Glow.

rotation: Opener: Basic P2-P4 (instant cancel) -> Overflowing Radiance (instant cancel) -> Liberation -> Incarnation Basics P1-P4 (dash/instant cancels) -> Illuminous Epiphany -> Outro. Loop: Intro -> Overflowing Radiance -> Incarnation Basics -> Crescent Divinity -> Illuminous Epiphany -> Outro, alternating with the secondary buffer's own rotation so Jinhsi gets ~2 Forte nukes + 1 Liberation per cycle.
communityNotes: Prydwen review: defined the early-game meta via accessible teammates and ease of use, but has not received strong new teammates since patch 1.3 (Coordinated Attack archetype largely dead since 2.2); considered powercrept by 3.2 but still viable in Tower/Endstate Matrix with optimized crit-fishing due to high rotation optimization ceiling (swap/animation/jump cancels). Weak in multi-wave content like Whimpering Wastes.
